_comment: Drop this into the 'mcpServers' block of your Claude Code settings (~/.claude/settings.json or per-project .mcp.json). Then mention @gat-scorer in your chat and Claude Code will call into it.

mcpServers._comment_multi: To run multiple GATs side-by-side (one per disease, for instance), add more entries under different keys. Claude Code namespaces tools by server name, so tool calls stay unambiguous:
